label: 📝 짧은 대본
message:
/input 대본의 소재는? (장소나 사건 한 줄) | /setvar key=소재 {{pipe}} ||

/if left={{getvar::소재}} right="" rule=eq {:

    /echo color=blue "대본 작성을 취소했어요." |

    /abort :} ||

/gen <System> Hold the roleplay for a moment and write a short stage script. Subject: [{{getvar::소재}}]

Use the characters and the situation built up so far. Rules:

- Start directly with the script; no preface such as 'Sure, here it is'.
- Write 3-4 scenes, each under a Markdown heading (### Scene 1, ...).
- Every scene must relate to {{getvar::소재}}.
- Use only character lines, bracketed stage directions, and one-line scene notes.
- Keep each character's usual way of speaking.
</System> |
/comment
